note: Sixth shop of the B07 covered arcade (glass skylight, honey limestone, dark oak joinery, as on the exterior): the general store, with cream walls, cobalt-blue trim and a speckled terrazzo floor. LANDMARK: the tall back wall of glass jars on oak shelves with a brass rolling ladder. The oak doorway on the far left shows the emerald jeweller's with its round safe door (way back); the arched doorway on the far right shows the butter-yellow corner shop with its bay window (next shop). Feminine nouns on the left, masculine on the right. Zoom: the till counter under the jar wall (z1).
